scoring_justification: Interaction energies and cis-trans energy difference can be recomputed from submitted total energies; activation energy checked against paper value as no TS total energy submitted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported interaction energies, cis-trans energy difference, activation energy, and O-H distances for the amide-alumina complexes.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: From the paper's Figure 5 and text: cis/trans energy difference 10 kJ/mol, activation energy 83 kJ/mol, interaction energies and distances as reconstructed from the paper's description.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed from the paper's theoretical calculations section and Figure 5. The solve.sh hardcoded values consistent with these.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the actual paper-reported computational results; they serve as the reference for scoring the agent's reproduction.

outputs.description: The artifact reports total energies and derived interaction energies, O···H distances, and conformational energetics. The verifier recomputes derived quantities from total energies and checks them against hidden paper gold values within tolerances; it also validates relative trends (e.g., interaction energy differences, bonding strength ratios).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker uses tolerances appropriate for independent code implementations (energies ≤ 2 kJ/mol, distances ≤ 0.01 nm) and verifies relative ordering constraints.
